newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orix says to write off all bad loans by March 1998.
newsitem.headline: Orix says to write off all bad loans by March 1998.

text.p: Orix Corp, a top leasing company that has extended its business into diversified fields, said on Thursday that it plans to finish writing off all of its bad loans by the end of the current fiscal year to March 1998.
Orix also said it expects its annual earnings to climb after it completes the write-offs.
"I expect our earnings to improve greatly after we finish writing off the loans," Yoshihiko Miyauchi, president and group chief executive officer, told Reuters.
But he added that he could not give a forecast for the year to March 1999, as much would depend on the economy and interest rate levels.
In May, Orix forecast group profit of 20 billion yen for the current year to March 1998, up from an actual profit of 19.04 billion yen a year earlier.
By March 1997, Orix had increased reserves for loan losses to 117.56 billion yen, compared with 81.88 billion yen a year earlier.
